title: Deutsche Bank reports cutting some loan approvals from weeks to minutes
dek: The bank says its AI-enabled corporate lending process accelerates narrower cases while using a managed internal agent platform.
evidence: Executive statements in Reuters; no independently audited accuracy or default-rate comparison
takeaway: Measure throughput together with exception handling, underwriting quality and auditability rather than decision speed alone.

sections.title: Context

bullets.detail: Corporate underwriting requires financial statements, compliance checks, risk models and human approval; latency may reflect workflow handoffs as much as calculation.

paragraphs: Loan decisions are document-heavy: Corporate underwriting requires financial statements, compliance checks, risk models and human approval; latency may reflect workflow handoffs as much as calculation.

sections.title: What's new

bullets.detail: Deutsche Bank's technology chief said some smaller-company loan decisions now take minutes instead of weeks, and some complex multinational cases fell from months to weeks.
The bank describes ADA, a shared environment for building, monitoring and controlling agents, managing model risk and switching model backends.

paragraphs: Faster simple cases: Deutsche Bank's technology chief said some smaller-company loan decisions now take minutes instead of weeks, and some complex multinational cases fell from months to weeks.
Governed agent platform: The bank describes ADA, a shared environment for building, monitoring and controlling agents, managing model risk and switching model backends.

sections.title: Evidence & limitations

bullets.detail: Reuters relays an executive claim rather than an independently matched before/after comparison of loans, risk tiers and error rates.
The report does not establish approval accuracy, defaults, fairness, exceptions or how much of the speedup is AI rather than process redesign.

paragraphs: Management-reported speed: Reuters relays an executive claim rather than an independently matched before/after comparison of loans, risk tiers and error rates.
Missing outcome evidence: The report does not establish approval accuracy, defaults, fairness, exceptions or how much of the speedup is AI rather than process redesign.

sections.title: Why it matters

bullets.detail: Evaluate decisions by complexity, data completeness, manual escalation rate and regulatory obligations.
Cycle time is valuable only with acceptable override rates, audit trail quality and credit loss performance.

paragraphs: Segment before generalizing: Evaluate decisions by complexity, data completeness, manual escalation rate and regulatory obligations.
